source_policy: Primary author-hosted books/notes; exact statements and theorem locations checked. Classical leaves are separate from stable project-claim dependencies.

inputs.name: Equivariant Hilbert class-field reciprocity
inputs.statement: For a totally complex number field K, the Galois group of its maximal everywhere-unramified abelian extension is Cl(K), by the Artin map. The isomorphism is equivariant under automorphisms of K.

sources.author: J. S. Milne
sources.title: Class Field Theory
sources.location: Chapter V, Theorem 3.6, Corollary 3.7, Example 3.9, pp. 158–159

inputs.qualification: Only finite-image unramified characters of a finite cyclotomic field are used. Equivariance is checked by conjugating Frobenius. No infinite-level class-group structure is assumed.

inputs.name: Kummer theory and the S-unit theorem
inputs.statement: When mu_l lies in K, H^1(G_K,mu_l)=K^*/K^{*l}; away from l, an unramified Kummer class has valuation divisible by l. The S-unit group has rank r_1+r_2-1+|S| and finite cyclic torsion.

sources.author: J. S. Milne
sources.title: Class Field Theory
sources.location: Chapter VII, Appendix A, Theorem A.3 and Proposition A.5, pp. 226–227

inputs.qualification: The Kummer Selmer cardinality sequence and the factor l^(2r) h_K are derived in OB4; they are not retained as extra inputs.

inputs.name: Minkowski ideal representative and conductor-discriminant formula
inputs.statement: Every ideal class of a degree-r number field has an integral ideal representative of norm at most (4/pi)^(r_2) r!/r^r sqrt(|Delta|). For an abelian number field, |Delta| is the product of the conductors of its characters.
inputs.qualification: All ideal-counting estimates and log h_K <= 3r log L are proved in OB4. No analytic class-number formula or L(1) estimate is imported.

inputs.name: von Staudt–Clausen Bernoulli denominators
inputs.statement: For positive even j the denominator of B_j divides the product of primes p with p-1 dividing j; B_1=-1/2 and B_j=0 for odd j>1.
inputs.qualification: Only denominators through order k are used. Fourier bounds, the primitive nonvanishing argument for k>=2, the Galois-stable product and the l-adic congruences are proved in the component.

inputs.name: Finite local fields and their integer rings
inputs.statement: The integers of a finite extension of Q_l form a complete DVR finite free over Z_l, and the l-adic absolute value extends uniquely.
inputs.qualification: Base change for cochains and local kernels, multiplication of length by the ramification index, character projectors, and norm/valuation cancellation are proved explicitly in OB3.

historical_comparisons_not_used.name: Exact integral Stickelberger annihilator
historical_comparisons_not_used.statement: For K=Q(zeta_L), theta_L=L^(-1) sum_{b in (Z/L)^*} b sigma_b^(-1). For an integer a prime to L, (sigma_a-a) theta_L is integral and annihilates Cl(K). Integral group-ring multiples also annihilate.
historical_comparisons_not_used.qualification: The proof uses -sigma_a^(-1)(sigma_a-a)theta_L and an integral multiple of the group norm. It does not use the false unrestricted rule that every rational multiplier making theta integral annihilates.
historical_comparisons_not_used.replaced_by: OS1 and the explicit odd-primary conversion in OB5
